title: Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 Review: KL's Independence-Day 21K
seo_title: Merdeka Half Marathon 2026 Review | Dataran Merdeka KL Race
meta_description: Merdeka Half Marathon 2026: August 23 at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur. An Independence-Day themed 21K at Malaysia's most historic square.
dek: Set for 23 August 2026 at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, this Merdeka-themed half marathon celebrates Malaysia's Independence Day at the country's most historic square.
verdict: The Merdeka Half Marathon is a Malaysian Independence Day race at Dataran Merdeka — the square where Malaysian independence was declared in 1957. Organised by JBSKL x KPM, it carries genuine patriotic resonance. The Merdeka theme typically means special-edition medals, national-colour race tees, and a finish-line atmosphere that's more celebratory than a standard commercial race. Registration details are pending. For runners wanting a KL half marathon with historical significance at the country's most iconic square, this is a meaningful pick.
